desc: PROPOSED ONE-SHOT (step 2 of the stage-2 preflight; 131 PASSED): tethered chainload of the USB-PROBE U-Boot variant — same reviewed stage-2 build plus CONFIG_PREBOOT='usb info; usb start; usb tree' (recipe: apple_t6040_stage2_defconfig + PREBOOT line + olddefconfig; double-built byte-identical). Composed image ~/Code/linux-build-out/uboot-stage2-probe-chainload.bin = m1n1 v3 c59d5820 + DTB 759d00ba + u-boot-nodtb f3da1c17 (550,624 B, image_size 1,031,760) + 481,136 zero B; total 2,181,215 B sha256 4069efa9; structure machine-verified. Run is a bounded 20 s wdt-self-recovering cycle (131-proven). ATTENDED: eyes on panel required — this run's whole value is the on-screen output of the PREBOOT usb commands. A passive bus-powered stick MAY be in the right port per the 108-series fixture rules (its presence changes nothing until R3). PASS = PMGR/DART/DWC3 probe without fault, xHCI registers, root hubs listed, EXPECTED zero devices; wdt reset; proxy self-return. STOP = SError/panic/freeze before prompt, any storage/NVMe output, proxy absent after reset (DebugUSB recovery). No SPMI/PMU/NVRAM writes exist in the artifact. Needs maintainer approve; author self-review recorded; sol review still waived per CJ. CROSS-REFERENCE 2026-07-25 (claude): ticket 128's static answer predicts the OUTCOME of this probe. AsahiLinux/u-boot asahi@8aa706b2 has NO real ATC-PHY/Type-C support: drivers/phy/phy-apple-atc.c is 55 lines with an EMPTY phy_ops struct and a no-op reset of_xlate (it binds a no-op UCLASS_PHY child purely so phandles resolve), its compatibles are apple,t6000-atcphy / apple,t8103-atcphy — not atc-phy,t6040 — and there is no drivers/usb/typec directory or tps6598x/tipd driver anywhere in the tree. U-Boot supplies the host-controller and storage stack (XHCI_HCD, XHCI_DWC3, DWC3, USB_KEYBOARD, NVME_APPLE) but nothing that establishes cable orientation, VBUS, eUSB2 repeater state or PHY lanes. PREDICTION: 'usb start; usb tree' will bring up the controller and enumerate NOTHING on the right port, exactly as Linux does today (root hubs only, tickets 063/064). If that is what happens, it is NOT a U-Boot config problem and no amount of defconfig work fixes it — it confirms the HPM/ATC host-link dependency (096/097 or 023). A device actually appearing would be genuinely surprising and would mean iBoot left the PHY warm for that port, which is worth capturing precisely. Evidence: evidence/2026-07-25-t6040-uboot-atcphy-answer.md. RUN 2026-08-02, RESULT: machine-verifiable criteria PASS — chainload log (linux-build-out/t132-chainload.log) shows 'Valid payload found' -> USB0/1/2 shutdown -> 'Vectoring to next stage'; probe U-Boot ran its bounded ~20 s window; wdt warm reset; enrolled loader + proxy self-returned (base 0x10004874000); released healthy. The PREBOOT 'usb info; usb start; usb tree' output is panel-only and was not captured by the author — maintainer may have observed; if not, rerun is one chainload of the same pinned image 4069efa9 with eyes on the panel. Prediction on record (root hubs only, zero devices) stands unless the panel showed otherwise.
